definition: a substance of two or more things mixed together
description: In a bright home kitchen a young man in a beanie makes a pancake. A knob of butter melts and slides across a large non-stick pan on the hob. He holds a ladle high over the pan and pours a thick pale batter into it in a steady stream; the batter spreads into a wide circle and bubbles rise on its surface. At the end he lifts the pan off the hob and tilts it towards the camera to show the browned pancake.

taps.phrase: to melt in the hot pan
to pour batter from a ladle
